blocks.text: STRANGE TIMES- We're living in a terrifying era, and the news reports it this way. We have surpassed the cities of the plains and even pagan Rome and the days of Noah, (the immorality and violence where their hearts were continually evil, 24 hours a day.) In almost every kind of media you can contact what you desire-no shame. The FBI is trying to stop it. They can buy drugs like ecstasy and those sold on the streets. Even after the great catastrophe in New York, Washington D.C., etc., nothing seems to slow down the shock waves of what isreleased. Our young people are living ina terrible viperous generation. — Add drugs to this and you really have a holocaust.

Some of the strange and most bizarre murders have occurred this year. No use repeating, I know you've heard it on the news. Some so inhuman that it’s hard to believe they could be on that level. — The Scripts prophecy is marching on with the Bible, And just think, both sexually and in the violence, children are involved also (Gen.19:4). But at the same time, while all the patriotism that is going on (which is good, but not by itself) you have to have the Lord Jesus! And right now He is working in a way never seen before gathering the called out ones! He has not only been out in the highways and hedges, but in most every part of the earth. This is the hour for His chosen children not only to watch and pray, but to witness in any way they can. — Because a great illusion has already covered the world. They’re trapped and later like a chameleon it will blend in with false religion, politics, society and all cults. If you’ve noticed, the sorcery pictures (in the movies) the last few years have taken in billions. The wizard dictator is near and the events we see now, he causes underneath that will make all people give homage. But praise the Lord, the Scripts have given you a great warning at the time.

(This was written in the Scripts fifteen years ago, but released again in 1995.) THE MARK CASTING ITS SHADOW BEFORE- “Foreboding and ominous signs are beginning to appear that was predicted by the Scripts for this decade!” — New type systems in money and identifications are appearing now and in the next year or so! For instance the microchip, (The News report says) is no bigger than a grain of rice and it can contain all of the information about the person that they need! And in the future they have a microchip that can be used in the same manner that sends out signals that can locate the person no matter where they go or hide! “In the hands of a dictator it means absolute control of those who are left behind on the earth!”...By computerized system, a person can do business anywhere on the earth without writing checks by just using their personalized number that is given to them!-End quote.

PROPHETIC UPDATE: Here is a recent news quote: Company readies ID chips for people. - Assoc. Press -‘A Florida technology company is poised to ask the government to market a first-ever computer ID chip that could be embedded beneath a person’s skin. For airports, nuclear power plants and other high-security facilities, the immediate benefits would be a close-to-fool-proof security system. But privacy advocates warn the chip could lead to encroachments on civil liberties. A computer chip, about the size of a grain of rice, that would be difficult to remove and tough to mimic. — Other possible uses of the technology, from an added device, would allow satellite tracking on an individual’s every movement to the storage of sensitive data like medical records. ‘The chip has drawn attention from religious groups. One theologian and author said he worries that the chip could be the ‘mark of the beast,’ an identifying mark that all people will be forced to wear just before end times, according to the Bible.” Note: No matter, one way or the other, because of the terrorist events and calamities, etc., the people will receive just as spoken - Revl3:16.

It won't be long, God’s celestial clock is revealing the beginning of things that will shake the entire planet. The last chapter of the Bible to the Elect is finishing, The great rock pyramid has foretold Sept1-17, 2001 that the planet would change into a total new conception of building and control. This is the way I was inspired to write, the way I felt. Of course the rock, it explained the finishing of time is near. It is actually a computer in stone. There are a few more things I will relate later; secrets of the memorial altar unto the Lord (Isa9:19-20). This age is the strangest than we’ve had in hundreds of years!

HEADLINES OF TOMORROW- (reprint from Scr.165, released 1989) — Besides the coming of Jesus, (which would be my favorite) I am going to list my prophetic headlines, future!” — GIANT QUAKES — huge parts of California slides into sea. — Top of buildings sinking! — Another headline — San Francisco in cataclysmic shambles! — “HEADLINES — GIANT ASTEROID hits in sea! — Tidal waves sends water over big cities — shipyards destroyed!” - Another one: “MONEY FAILS - new standard rises!” - “TERROR STRIKES THE WORLD! — Food shortage — Groceries and other products rationed — mark issued” — “New world leader speaks about his Plans!” — “Two strange men appear in Israel!” (prophets — Rev11) — Next — “WORLD AFLAME in war of wars!” — “EARTH’S GREATEST QUAKE - cities of the nations fall!” — “JESUS REIGNS IN JERUSALEM —New set of laws, a spiritual government!” — We could have done many other headlines of the future such as the last USA president (leader) — the coming weather pattern changes and storms and other signs, but this is enough to let you know time is short! End quote.

By looking at the following headlines you can see some of them are just like I wrote on the Scripts. THE WEATHER OF 2001- A Stormy Year in America - Weatherwise: Flooded trucks were scattered across I-10 in Houston, Tx. Following several days of heavy rain from Tropical Storm Allison in June 2001 With 41 deaths and $45 billion in damage, Allison was the deadliest and costliest tropical storm in U.S. history. Record Breaking Snowfalls — For an entire season, Erie, Pennsylvania, set a record with 147 inches of snow, besting the record set during the fierce winter of 1977-78. In South Dakota, Huron’s seasonal total of 85.1 inches beat a record from 1961-62. Buffalonians endured nearly seven feet of snow in December, the city’s all-time snowiest month on record. “Baked Alaska” — In Fairbanks, Alaska, the temperature climbed to 42 degrees on JanJ3th for only the 12th time ever in January. The reading was a whopping 45 degrees above normal. “Dry Sierra” - Reno, NV, measured only 1.22 inches of precipitation from Oct. 2000 through March 2001, the second driest start to the water year in more than 130 years of records.

Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea; Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah!
